categories.label: People Leadership & Team Growth
categories.description: hiring, growing, retaining and managing engineers: team size and span, performance management, career development, promotions, and how the team got better under this person.

categories.label: Delivery & Execution
categories.description: outcomes shipped through the team: roadmaps delivered, reliability and operational results, planning and process, and the measurable business impact of what the team built.

categories.label: Technical Judgement
categories.description: the technical depth to make credible architecture and trade-off calls, guide design reviews, and be trusted by senior engineers; usually grounded in a strong prior IC track record.

categories.label: Strategy & Cross-functional Influence
categories.description: partnership with product, business and customers; org design and prioritisation; communicating upward and outward; shaping what the team works on, not just how.

bonus_description: managing managers or multiple teams, org-wide initiatives (hiring programmes, platform strategy, engineering standards), budget or vendor ownership, public writing or talks on engineering leadership, building a team from scratch, leading distributed or remote teams.
